notes: Cyan/sapphire/obsidian brand language. Calm left/upper for icons and homepage text. Landscape 16:9 masters plus portrait variants for flagship entries.

prompts.name: Cyan Orbit
prompts.prompt: Premium desktop wallpaper for DevOS OS homepage, 16:9 wide. Deep ink navy to charcoal studio background. Soft luminous cyan orbital rings and a few tiny bright nodes orbiting a calm center-right glow, inspired by a modern developer OS boot motif. Large empty calm space on the left and upper-left for desktop icons and homepage text. Soft volumetric light, subtle film grain, physically believable glass-blue glow, restrained sophisticated palette of midnight navy and cyan. No text, no logo, no UI.

prompts.name: Sapphire Vein
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Deep sapphire navy field with one elegant translucent cyan light vein flowing diagonally center-right like polished glass light through dark stone. Quiet left third empty for icons and homepage headline. Soft rim lighting, cool cyan and deep blue only, no purple haze.

prompts.name: Glass Kernel
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. A single frosted glass kernel orb with soft cyan refraction sitting center-right on a dark slate studio background. Thin caustic light rings around it. Generous empty left and top margins for OS icons and homepage content.

prompts.name: Night Buffer
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9 for dark homepage. Soft layered night fog buffers in deep navy with a gentle cyan horizon glow low on the right. Extremely calm empty left half for desktop icons. Minimal abstract atmosphere.

prompts.name: Signal Fold
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Sculptural folded satin-glass ribbon in icy cyan and soft white catching light, concentrated on the right side. Pale cool silver-blue studio background. Large calm negative space upper-left for homepage hero text and icons.

prompts.name: Cobalt Drift
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Two overlapping drifting cobalt glass slabs with soft cyan edge light floating center-right over deep ink background. Calm empty left for icons and homepage.

prompts.name: Soft Lattice
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Extremely subtle soft 3D lattice of translucent cyan rods fading into deep navy, denser on the right, nearly empty on the left for desktop icons. Soft depth of field, elegant tech atmosphere without looking like a circuit board schematic.

prompts.name: Pearl Dawn
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS light-mode wallpaper 16:9 for homepage. Soft pearlescent white and ice-cyan dawn glow with gentle sculptural glass curve on the right. Airy pale silver background, large calm left negative space for icons and light UI.

prompts.name: Ink Horizon
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Nearly black ink field with a thin luminous cyan horizon line and soft glow low on the right third. Vast calm empty space above and left for homepage content. Minimal cinematic abstract.

prompts.name: Prism Dock
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Three floating frosted glass prisms docked in a soft diagonal on the right, casting cyan caustics on a dark charcoal floor gradient. Empty left half for icons.

prompts.name: Aurora Shell
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Soft restrained cyan-teal aurora shell curling gently across the upper-right sky over deep midnight, quiet reflective dark ground. Large calm left for icons and homepage. Elegant subtle aurora not neon overload.

prompts.name: Terminal Glow
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Abstract ambient desk atmosphere: soft cyan glow reflecting on dark matte surface from the right, shallow depth of field, no keyboard no screen no UI visible, just light and mood for a developer OS. Empty left composition for icons.

prompts.name: Frost Panel
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Tall overlapping frosted glass panels standing center-right with soft cyan edge light and pale ice refraction, glacial cool studio background. Calm open left area for desktop icons.

prompts.name: Graphite Halo
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Monumental soft graphite halo ring with brushed metal edge and faint cyan rim light on near-black background. Subject on right, large empty left. Minimalist luxury OS aesthetic.

prompts.name: Azure Ribbon
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. One continuous flowing azure satin-glass ribbon sweeping from lower center to upper right with luminous cyan highlights on deep navy. Spacious calm left for homepage text.

prompts.name: Quiet Mesh
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Soft translucent mesh fabric of pale cyan and silver gently draped on the right over a cool gray-blue atmosphere. Very calm open left for icons.

prompts.name: Ember Trace
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Deep charcoal background with a refined dual-tone light trace: soft champagne gold meeting cool cyan in a thin elegant arc on the right. Luxury premium accent. Empty left for icons and homepage.

prompts.name: Liquid Lens
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Giant liquid glass lens dome on the right refracting soft cyan and sapphire light, dark studio surround. Physically accurate refraction and caustics, calm empty left composition for desktop icons.

prompts.name: Void Ring
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS wallpaper 16:9. Near-black void with one precise thin cyan luminous ring floating center-right and a soft radial falloff. Ultra minimal monumental composition, large empty left for homepage hero content.

prompts.name: Home Bloom
prompts.prompt: Premium DevOS homepage hero wallpaper 16:9. Soft radial cyan bloom from mid-right over deep navy, gentle glass petal-like translucent layers opening quietly, lots of open dark space on the left for brand title and CTA. Elegant premium atmosphere matching a polished developer OS.
